# Discord triggers

![Adding a trigger: on the Actions page, click + Trigger and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-trigger-picker.png)

## Bot connected

Runs when your Discord bot comes online in Cuebot.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%botName%` | Your bot's name |

<small>Type id: `discord.connected`</small>

## Bot disconnected

Runs when your Discord bot goes offline, for example when the internet drops. Cuebot tries to bring it back by itself.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | Why it went offline, in plain words |

<small>Type id: `discord.disconnected`</small>

## Member joined the server

Runs when someone joins your Discord server. Good for a welcome message or a starter role. Needs "Server Members Intent" switched on, on the Discord bot page and in the Developer Portal.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The new member's name |
| `%userName%` | Their Discord user name |
| `%userId%` | Their Discord user ID |
| `%mention%` | Pings them when put in a message, like "Welcome %mention%!" |
| `%serverName%` | The name of the server they joined |
| `%isBot%` | True when the new member is a bot |

<small>Type id: `discord.memberJoined`</small>

## Message posted in a channel

Runs when someone posts a message in a channel your bot can see. To read the text, tick "Message Content Intent" on the Discord bot page and in the Developer Portal.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channel** | Only messages in this channel. Pick it from the list or type its name, like #suggestions. Leave it empty for every channel. |
| **Text contains** | Only messages with these words in them, like "!clip". Capital letters do not matter. Leave it empty for every message. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%message%` | What they wrote (empty unless Message Content Intent is switched on) |
| `%user%` | The person's name as the server shows it |
| `%userName%` | Their Discord user name |
| `%userId%` | Their Discord user ID |
| `%channelName%` | The channel's name, without the # |
| `%channelId%` | The channel's ID |
| `%serverName%` | The name of your server |
| `%messageLink%` | A link to the message |
| `%discordMessageId%` | The message's ID |

<small>Type id: `discord.messagePosted`</small>

## Slash command used

Runs when someone uses one of your bot's slash commands in your Discord server, like /socials. Answer with the "Reply to slash command" step.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The command name without the slash, like "socials". Several names separated by commas work too. Leave it empty to run for every command. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%command%` | The command that was used, without the slash, like socials |
| `%option%` | What the person typed in the command's text box (empty when there is none) |
| `%optionName%` | The name of that text box |
| `%user%` | The person's name as the server shows it (their nickname if they have one) |
| `%userName%` | Their Discord user name |
| `%userId%` | Their Discord user ID. Handy for the "Give a role" step |
| `%channelId%` | The ID of the channel where they used it |
| `%channelName%` | The name of that channel, without the # |
| `%serverName%` | The name of your server |
| `%discordInteractionId%` | Tells the "Reply to slash command" step which command use to answer. Leave it alone |

<small>Type id: `discord.slashCommand`</small>
